en.headline: Chan outlines four priorities for Apec finance ministers meeting
en.dek: The Financial Secretary said the Hong Kong gathering will focus on livelihood-supporting fiscal policies, digital infrastructure, inclusive finance and young talent.
body: Financial Secretary Paul Chan said in his weekly blog that the Apec Finance Ministers’ Meeting in Hong Kong this month will centre on four areas of strength for the city: fiscal policies supporting livelihoods, digital infrastructure financing, inclusive finance, and the development of young financial talent.

He wrote that hosting the meeting highlights the central government’s support and the city’s status as a regional international financial centre. About 500 guests from Apec’s 21 member economies are expected at the Convention and Exhibition Centre on 20 and 21 October, the first time Hong Kong hosts the event.
The meeting is organised by the Hong Kong government and hosted by the Ministry of Finance of the People’s Republic of China.

zh.headline: 陳茂波：APEC財長會聚焦民生財政、數字基建等四優先領域
zh.dek: 財政司司長指這四項屬香港優勢，首次在港舉行反映國家支持及本港國際金融中心地位。
body: 財政司司長陳茂波在周日網誌表示，本月在港舉行的亞太經合組織財長會議將聚焦四項香港優勢領域，包括支持民生的財政政策、數字基礎設施融資、普惠金融及青年財經人才。
他寫道，由香港承辦會議凸顯中央政府對本港的支持，亦反映香港作為區內重要國際金融中心的地位。會議將於10月20及21日在灣仔會議展覽中心舉行，預計約500名來自21個成員經濟體的嘉賓出席。
這是香港首次承辦該會議，由國家財政部主辦、特區政府承辦。
